stem: How did Marcus Garvey MOST impact African Americans in the early 1900s?
instruction: Read the list and answer the question that follows.

options.label: A
options.text: By desegregating schools and urban neighborhoods

options.label: B
options.text: By urging blacks to accept low-paying jobs and social inequality

options.label: C
options.text: By promoting black cultural pride and economic independence

options.label: D
options.text: By supporting the use of violence to overthrow government and win reforms

visual_elements:
Selected Achievements of Marcus Garvey
• Founded the Universal Negro Improvement Association
• Established the Black Star Line steamship corporation
• Established the weekly newspaper Negro World for people of African descent
